description: A function starting with `use` that lets components use React features such as state (`useState`), effects (`useEffect`) or context (`useContext`).
React matches Hook calls to stored values by their position in the render. The order must be the same on every render.
The body of a component or custom Hook, outside conditions, loops, nested functions, `try/catch` and code after an early `return`.
A function named `useSomething` that calls other Hooks. It shares **logic**; every caller gets its own state.
Official lint plugin with `rules-of-hooks` and `exhaustive-deps`, plus compiler-powered diagnostics in recent versions.
